author: Michael
title: SOCOM Wants an Ultra-Lightweight Machine Gun
text:
Mojave STOL: Rugged. Real. Ready Today.
Remote missions demand real flexibility. Whether launching from a warship at sea or a dirt strip in the middle of the jungle, General Atomics Aeronautical Systems’ Mojave STOL is a rugged, multi-mission UAS that warfighters can count on anywhere.
See it here: https://www.ga-asi.com/remotely-piloted-aircraft/mojave
US Special Operations Command is after a 10-pound, belt-fed 5.56 machine gun that works with high-pressure ammo and "Visual Augmentation Systems" to bring operators into the 21st Century.
The requirements and timeline are bold, but necessary if our Special Operations Forces intend to stay mobile and deadly on today’s battlefields.
In this video, we talk about:
– The SOCOM requirements
– Why they need this Flyweight Assault Machine Gun
– What might fit the bill that exists today – KAC LAMG, FN Evolys, SIG Sauer unknown?
Recorded on: August 11, 2026
Written/Edited by: Kyle Gunn
Story: https://taskandpurpose.com/news/special-operations-machine-gun/
